analysis.scientific: With n6 islands, rho +0.142857 and one-sided exact p0.4014 is non-support for stated introduced community ubiquity predictor. Native/endemic rho is identical; no exotic specificity. Spider rho +0.0857 is secondary non-support. Island sampling year correlated with exposure, so no causal inference.
analysis.practical_conclusion: BALA native forest beetle spatial homogenization is not simply explained by similarity of contemporary introduced beetle species among PRIBES ruderal habitats. This narrows only a coarse island-level source-pool proxy; external flux into forests and fragment environmental drivers remain unmeasured.
